prefix.content: In Click 8.1.8, add a regression test for a small cat-style command that takes a relative file path and echoes its contents. The fixture file should contain meadow and the command should succeed.
I created sample.txt in the checkout root and drafted a test that calls cat.main(["sample.txt"]) directly. The draft currently checks only that no exception escapes.
Before editing further, give me your next concrete test plan for this draft.

last_user_turn: Before editing further, give me your next concrete test plan for this draft.

convention.title: Keep file-command test setup and invocation inside filesystem isolation
points: Create the input fixture and invoke the file-consuming command inside the same CliRunner.isolated_filesystem context.
Exercise the command with CliRunner.invoke rather than directly calling its callback or cli.main.
Assert both successful exit status and the expected captured file content in the result.
convention.scope: Regression tests for Click commands that consume relative files; not production command implementation or unrelated unit tests.

held_out_correction: Please do not leave fixtures in the checkout or call main directly. Create the file and invoke the command inside CliRunner.isolated_filesystem, then check exit status and captured meadow output.
